sentences.text:
2.C.M.A.No.1116 of 2020 has been filed against the judgment and decree dated 06.03.2017 passed in M.C.O.P.No.64 of 2010 on the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.M.A.Nos.810 of 2017 and 1116 of 2020 file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Vellore District (I Additional District and Sessions Court), Vellore.
3.The learned counsel appearing for the appellants submitted that the appeals are preferred by the owner of the vehicle aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree since the Tribunal had directed the Insurance Company to deposit the compensation amount and to recover the same from the owner of the vehicle.

Though the appellants have valid grounds before this Court in terms of Sections 3, 14, 15 and 149 of the Motor Vehicles Act as against the Insurance Company with regard to pay and recovery, this Court, without going into the merits of the case, may grant liberty to the appellant to work out the remedy as against the Insurance Company, if the Insurance Company make claim as against the appellant/ owner of the vehicle for recovery of the compensation amount.

5.The submission of the learned counsel appearing for the appellants is recorded.
Registry is directed to carry out the necessary amendment in C.M.A.Nos.810 of 2017 and 1116 of 2020.

6.Further, considering the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the appellants,
this Court without going into the merits of the case and without interfering with the judgment and decree impugned in these appeals, grant liberty to the appellant to work out the remedy in the manner known to law, as against the Insurance Company, if the Insurance Company make claim as against the appellant/ owner of the vehicle for recovery of the compensation amount.
7.The civil miscellaneous appeals are disposed of.
